description.value: Taste of Africa is a West African and Ghanaian restaurant in Surrey specializing in slow-cooked, handcrafted dishes like Jollof Rice, Fufu with Okra or Palm Nut soup, Pounded Yam, and baked Tilapia with pepper sauce. Rated 4.4 stars from over 460 reviews, it is praised for its warm, family-friendly atmosphere and genuine homemade flavors rooted in authentic West African culinary tradition. Touring cyclists passing through Surrey on King George Boulevard will find both dine-in and pickup options available.
